liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): Reviewer hears it as if it emerged out of some other cosmic jam [2]

## The recordings

- **gd70-07-01.sbd.cotsman.9624.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 3 songs; 17 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Fair amount of distortion and overmodulation throughout most of the recording; Warble is present in Candyman, improving toward the end of the song [1]

## Around the show

- These are the only tracks on the archive from the Festival Express train tour across Canada, which Robert Hunter wrote about in "Might as Well" [2]
- Reviewer considers Janis Joplin's performance of 'Cry Baby' in the film about the best live performance they have seen [3]
- The Festival Express DVD includes Don't Ease Me In, Hard To Handle and a New Speedway Boogie [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-07-01.sbd.cotsman.9624.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon, Raoul Duke and JCotsman; source: Soundboard [1]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Winnipeg Fairgrounds - July 1, 1970](https://www.dead.net/show/july-1-1970) [6]
- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [1970-07-01 Winnipeg Fairgrounds, Winnipeg, Manatoba - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1970-07-01-winnipeg-fairgrounds-winnipeg-manatoba/) [7]
